final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(modindex) as avg_modindex FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) as overall_avg FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT step1.telescref, step1.avg_modindex, step1.avg_modindex - step2.overall_avg as difference FROM step1, step2 WHERE step1.avg_modindex > step2.overall_avg), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) as avg_modindex_step3 FROM step3) SELECT step3.telescref, step3.avg_modindex, step3.difference, step3.avg_modindex / step4.avg_modindex_step3 as ratio FROM step3, step4 WHERE step4.avg_modindex_step3 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10
